messages:
Jane (ACME): Hey, hitting a bunch of failures when using JSON mode for our order-streaming job. Some responses are invalid JSON and our parser crashes.  
Luis: Sorry to hear that — can you paste an example response and the API call you used?
Jane (ACME): Sending a sanitized snippet:  
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "mode": "json",
  "schema": { "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["order_id", "amount"] } },
  "prompt": "stream orders"
}
```
Response stream (partial chunks concatenated):
```
[{"order_id":"o_1","amount":120},{"order_id":"o_2"  
{"order_id":"o_3","amount":45,"extra":"unexpected"},
{"amount":30}
]
```
Last two objects are malformed/partial; 2nd object missing closing brace in chunk, 4th missing order_id. Parser throws "missing required key order_id" and then we retry which causes duplicate billing.
Priya: That looks like a streaming split issue — sometimes chunk boundaries split in the middle of an object and clients that concatenate raw chunks end up with invalid JSON. Do you see a 401/latency spike around the same time?
Jane (ACME): Yes, we saw intermittent 401s for a minute and latency jumped ~2x before we retried. Billing spike due to retries.
Luis: Can you share request headers (esp. Authorization and Content-Length) and which SDK/client version you use?
Jane (ACME): Using our in-house stream consumer (node) that listens to chunks and appends to a buffer, no special SDK.
Sam: Two things to try fast: 1) set mode to "json_mode: "per-item"" (if available) so server delimits complete items, 2) ensure your consumer waits for a "
]" close or uses the "item" events from the SDK instead of raw chunk concatenation.
Luis: Can you repro with curl? If so, please paste exact curl and the raw bytes we can inspect.
Jane (ACME): Repro steps I ran quickly: 
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"mode":"json","prompt":"stream orders"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Output truncated: sometimes we see `
{"order_id":"o_2"
` (no closing brace) then next chunk `{"order_id":"o_3",...}`; other times items missing required keys.
Priya: I checked platform logs (correlating with your thread id) — DeployBot shows a transient auth validation error around that window (DeployBot: token verification backend timed out, returned 500 -> client observed 401). During that time stream multiplexing had higher buffer pressure and chunking got non-atomic.
DeployBot: Incident note: auth-validate had a 60s GC pause on 2024-11-05T14:23Z, causing backend 5xx for ~40s; retry layer returned 401 to clients intermittently.
Luis: So root cause chain: auth subsystem instability -> upstream retries & transient disconnects -> streaming boundaries split -> client concatenation produces partial/missing fields -> parser errors & duplicate retries -> billing spike.
Sam: Workarounds: 
- Short-term: switch client consumer to parse per-line JSON or incremental parse (safest: treat each "}," or newline-delimited item as candidate and validate with a tolerant parser). Avoid blind concat-then-parse.
- Medium: set json_mode to "per-item" or request server to emit explicit item boundaries (we can toggle on per-customer basis).
- Long-term: we'll harden auth backend and add stronger streaming guarantees for json-mode (server will buffer until object-close when auth backend is slow).
Jane (ACME): Can you change server-side behavior for our org? This is hitting production and causing billing/regression.
Priya: We can enable per-item framing for your tenant as a rollback while we fix auth. I'll open an internal change and link you the temporary flag.
Luis: Also please share a minimal reproducible test (small script) we can run against staging to verify the framing toggle fixes your parser.
Jane (ACME): Attaching a tiny node script (sanitized):
```
const https = require('https')
const req = https.request({ method: 'POST', host: 'api.redwood.example', path: '/v1/generate', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer sk-XXXX', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }, res => {
  res.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk))
})
req.write(JSON.stringify({ mode: 'json', prompt: 'stream orders' }))
req.end()
```
When auth flaps it prints partial objects.
Priya: Got it. We'll enable the per-item framing flag for your tenant in staging and let you know. Also suggest client patch: incremental JSON parsing (e.g., https://github.com/stream-json/stream-json) to avoid throwing on partial chunks.
Jane (ACME): Thanks — any ETA on auth fix?
Priya: We rolled a mitigation to auth-validate (reduced GC window) and will monitor for 24h. I put a ticket to fully rewrite the validation worker (ETA 2 weeks).
Luis: Follow-ups: 
- We will enable per-item framing for ACME in staging in the next 30m.
- Support to provide a billing credit for duplicated retries while we investigate (I've flagged billing).
Jane (ACME): Really appreciate the quick help. Will validate staging and post back. :raised_hands:﻿
Sam: Note to ENG: track streaming integrity in the canary tests — add a test that injects auth 5xx mid-stream and ensures json-mode still yields well-formed items.
Luis: Marking for escalation to eng-runtime if framing toggle doesn't fully resolve.
Jane (ACME): Verified staging with framing flag ON — no broken items observed in ~10k items. Thanks all.
